connect.title: Connect Account
connect.subtitle: Sign in with Cloudflare, or paste an API token. We verify the credential and discover the accounts it can manage.
connect.oauthNotConfigured: Register an OAuth client in the Cloudflare dashboard (Manage account → OAuth clients) and set its client id in app config to enable sign-in.
connect.help: Create a token at dash.cloudflare.com → My Profile → API Tokens. It needs at least Account · Account Settings · Read. Credentials are stored only on this device, in the secure keychain.
